# AI Architect Mastery (AAM)

> AI Architect Mastery publishes the AI Driven Development Methodology: a human-led, vendor-neutral method for engineering software with AI agents. Humans own intent, scope and decisions; agents perform bounded work through PRD → PLAN → TASK → IMPLEMENTATION. Review and evidence do not automatically authorize release.

This is a supplementary directory of public references, not an access policy or a promise of search inclusion. The HTML pages are the public content reference.

## Methodology

- [Methodology overview](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/): Definition, human responsibility and the four-phase workflow.
- [PRD](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/prd.html): Intent, scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.
- [PLAN](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/plan.html): A reviewed, dependency-aware implementation approach.
- [TASK](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/task.html): Bounded delegation with context and expected evidence.
- [IMPLEMENTATION](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/methodology/implementation.html): Execution, verification and a human decision.

The methodology pages are reference-only: no course enrollment is required.

## AAM Agent Workflow and Courses

- [AAM Agent Workflow](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/agent-workflow/): A free template repository for the AI Driven Development Methodology (PRD, PLAN, TASK, IMPLEMENTATION), delivered as plain Markdown files: templates for the PRD, PLAN and TASK, an IMPLEMENTATION review checklist and reusable prompts. The email signup takes you to the repository and starts a three-day onboarding guide. It is not an agent or an installer, and nothing runs on its own.
- [Current course information](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/#courses): The site lists GitHub Copilot GH-300 preparation with a Udemy link. Check the linked provider for current availability and pricing. Mastering AI Driven Development is marked coming soon, not available for enrollment.

## GH-300 Certification Documentation

- [GH-300 hub](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/): Six free written study guides, using the January 2026 study-guide baseline. These pages are not six separately available courses.
- [Responsible AI](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/responsible-ai.html): Responsible AI principles and limitations.
- [Copilot features](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/copilot-features.html): Copilot interfaces and capabilities.
- [Data and architecture](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/data-and-architecture.html): Context, data flow and model limitations.
- [Prompt engineering](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/prompt-engineering.html): Prompt structure and context.
- [Developer productivity](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/developer-productivity.html): Development use cases and their limits.
- [Privacy and safeguards](https://aiarchitectmastery.com/gh-300/privacy-and-safeguards.html): Privacy settings and safeguards.
- [Official GH-300 study guide](https://aka.ms/GH300-StudyGuide): Provider reference for current exam objectives; each domain guide also links its technical sources.
